verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a desktop OS layer, so bulk operations across many items is a fair question, but the evidence documents no bulk or batch-operation capability. A theme restyling the whole system at once, and fip forwarding one or more ports, are adjacent single-action features. The omarchy CLI being agent-controllable is only a building block, not a bulk-operations feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
